about_the_game:
Welcome to the word's first "owl-like": Parliament! As an owl, you must catch prey and defeat predators, growing stronger and gaining abilities to take down the fearsome Brown Bear. Explore each level and find secrets, navigate randomly generated enemies, using your flight to your advantage, and overall just being an owl. How long can you survive?

Did we mention the Brown Bear summons lightning? Yeah, it does that...

  • World's first "owl-like"

    • It's basically a roguelike, but you play an owl. Death resets your hard earned stats and abilities back to default. Use flight and movement to your advantage to survive the harsh wilderness! Consume prey for stat boosts and defeat predators for special abilities!

 

  • Cozy, but scary

    • Parliament can be a relaxing game to fly around in, until a wolf decides they want to eat you... Explore each level, relax to the music and soak in the visual style while you level up and prepare to face the Brown Bear!

  • Based on real life, but not too much

    • All critters, environments and abilities in the game are based on the real life ecosystem of an owl. Do owls throw feathers at their enemies? Probably not, but at least they aren't shooting out laser beams. Wait, the bear does that... crap. Mostly-based-on-real-life-ecosystem*

----PARLIAMENT IS A WORK IN PROGRESS----

During this demo, you will likely find bugs, opportunities for improvement, and general weirdness. We were so excited to share the game with the world, we didn't want to wait any longer. Also, this lets you see how the game will grow and change over time and hopefully provide some insight into our realm of making games!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel 9th gen and up or Ryzen 3000 and up
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or RX5700XT
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
